fields.topology_type: Point-to-point chip-to-chip over N bonded SerDes lanes per direction; Protocol-over-Framing-over-SerDes layering.

supported_topologies.name: Bonded multi-lane link
supported_topologies.description: Words striped round-robin across N SerDes lanes; each lane self-framed with its own metaframe.

supported_topologies.name: Channelized multiplex
supported_topologies.description: Up to 65536 logical channels share the physical link, selected by the Burst Control Word channel number.

fields.lane_bonding: Round-robin striping across N lanes; receiver deskews on metaframe boundaries and clock-compensates with Skip Words.
